title: Read-only master data cards and templates preflight
purpose: Inspect customer, vendor, item and location card/list/template surfaces before any Universaarl master data is created.

smartDecision.whyNow: TARGET-034 allows only read-only master data preflight. Actual master data creation remains locked while Page 314 and VAT setup are parked.
smartDecision.risk: Clicking New or accepting a template dialog could create a record too early.
smartDecision.fallback: If a page opens a create/template dialog, capture the dialog and close or cancel without confirming.

entryCriteria: TARGET-034 result exists and classifies master data creation as locked but read-only preflight as useful.
Business Central must stay in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer, Vendor, Item and Location surfaces are classified as readable, blocked, or risky.
Required fields, visible posting-group fields, template prompts and abort logic are documented.
No record is created or edited.
No setup, draft, Preview Posting or Posting occurs.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-034 classified Foundation as partial and allowed only read-only master-data card/template preflight.
nextStepDecision.reason: Master-data list surfaces must be visible and screenshot-qualified before any controlled New/template/create case can be attempted.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The next step must decide which first record can be created and which fields/templates stay locked.
Preview remains blocked until real master data, accepted VAT/posting boundaries and expected entry traces exist.
Posting remains blocked until preview evidence and expected ledger/subledger traces exist.
Parked Page 314, VAT matrix, inventory posting and default-dimension blockers can be revisited after the first master-data route decision.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: The first controlled write decision must choose one low-risk record family and keep templates/save actions gated.
risksBeforeNextCase: New/template actions can create records if confirmed blindly.
No master-data creation should occur before setup-field decisions are explicit.
requiredPreparation: Do not treat list visibility as proof of mandatory field completeness.

proved: 4/4 master-data pages opened read-only in playthru/UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No customer, vendor, item or location was created.
No template was applied, no save/create was confirmed, no preview/posting occurred.
notProved: Templates and mandatory fields are not fully proven because New/Create was intentionally not confirmed.
Posting groups, VAT groups and number-series readiness for actual new cards are not proven.
No Default Dimensions, ledger entries, VAT entries, item entries or value entries exist from this case.
Final clean book screenshots are not proven because Teaching Tips remain visible on the captured pages.
Card mandatory fields are not proven because New/Create was not opened or confirmed.

findings: Customers, Vendors, Items and Locations list pages are visibly in playthru / Universaarl GmbH context.
Each page shows an empty-list state and a visible Neu/New action, but Neu was not clicked.
Customers, Vendors and Items show Teaching Tips about templates; Locations shows a Teaching Tip about warehouse/location setup.
Teaching Tips are useful learning evidence but obscure the lower-left area; final book screenshots should close them or explain them deliberately.
Item page FactBox is scrolled and reveals many planning/factoring fields; this is useful for field discovery but not proof of mandatory card fields.
